en: This postcard shows a historic European town square with several old buildings, shops, and a large, imposing church with a distinctive stepped gable roof. There are vendors with market stalls set up in the foreground and people walking in the streets. The church dominates the scene and has tall, narrow arched windows. The scene is rendered in sepia tones, giving it an early 20th-century appearance. The text printed on the postcard is in German and includes the location and publisher details.
